name: UrbanReplayBench
description: UrbanReplayBench is a de-identified, cutoff-safe dataset for evaluatingLLM-planned multi-engine urban evidence under streaming, availability,and silent-corruption faults. The release contains 23 event cases, 68 replay cutoffs, 13 Parquetfiles, 91,254 relational rows, and 7,323 cutoff-safe road-link rows.It includes event and cutoff manifests, relational replay snapshots,City2Graph inputs, document source/version provenance metadata, sealedfault manifests, evaluation decisions, reports, and SHA-256 checksums. The historical observed_at field is a normalized observation-timeproxy computed as floor_5min(collection_time - 15 minutes).The published_at field represents collector-side availability, notthe source agency's internal publication time. The original PostgreSQL dump, credentials, policy-document full text,personal identifiers, and generated Microsoft GraphRAG indexes areexcluded.
